lines.text: You didn't know governments can literally create new money.

lines.text: What if I told you that money can be created out of thin air?

lines.text: No printing machine. No gold. Just numbers.

lines.text: But this is how part of the modern financial system works.

lines.text: In many countries, central banks can create new money electronically.

lines.text: Imagine a central bank wants to put more money into the financial system.

lines.text: It can buy government bonds from banks or other investors.

lines.text: Creating more money doesn't automatically make everyone richer.

lines.text: If spending grows faster than the economy can produce goods and services, prices can rise.

lines.text: So creating money is one thing.

lines.text: Creating real wealth is something completely different.
